scope: Public primary-source research for SZL Foundation Confirmation v0.4. These are design antecedents, not evidence of agency endorsement, classified access, AGI, or novel SZL capabilities.

records.organization: CIA Center for the Study of Intelligence
records.title: Psychology of Intelligence Analysis, Chapter 8: Analysis of Competing Hypotheses
records.author: Richards J. Heuer, Jr.
records.sections_read: Chapter 8, especially printed pages 101-105, 108-109; publication notice on PDF page 5
records.source_finding: Assess how evidence distinguishes alternatives, revisit decisive observations, and expose conclusions that depend on fragile assumptions. The method does not guarantee correctness.
records.proposed_adaptation: Log observation provenance; compare stable-world and sensor-failure explanations; make a separate verification action available when one observation controls the conclusion.
records.adoption_status: Recommendation; implementation and performance must be established by the v0.4 code and results.
records.license_observation: The publication warns of possible copyright restrictions and prohibits commercial copying. Only a short original summary and a source link are retained; the PDF is not redistributed.
records.boundary: Author's views in a public CIA-hosted publication; not a description of classified systems or a guarantee from CIA. Our probabilistic sensor model is not presented as the ACH algorithm.

records.organization: NSA Artificial Intelligence Security Center and co-sealing agencies
records.title: NSA's AISC Releases Joint Guidance on the Risks and Best Practices in AI Data Security
records.sections_read: Official release paragraphs describing data integrity, provenance, signatures, and drift
records.source_finding: The release recommends tracing data provenance, authenticating revisions, and protecting data throughout development and operation. It identifies modification and drift as reliability risks.
records.proposed_adaptation: Preserve immutable source/data/model hashes and acquisition identities; distinguish integrity of an observation record from truth of its reported value.
records.adoption_status: Recommendation; existing hash receipts can be extended with channel and dependency metadata.
records.license_observation: Public official press release; no software or dataset license assessed, and no external material imported.
records.boundary: Press release read. Its linked full CSI PDF returned a browser retrieval error and was not used as if read. Hashes do not establish observation accuracy; this study does not claim compliance certification.

records.title: REASON: Rapid Explanation, Analysis and Sourcing Online
records.dated_reference: The page lists a solicitation release date of 2023-03-20; this is not asserted to be the web page publication date.
records.sections_read: Intelligence Value, Summary, solicitation dates and status
records.source_finding: REASON seeks additional and contrary evidence and critiques of reasoning. Its public description calls for independent testing and evaluation of systems assisting analysts.
records.proposed_adaptation: Define a falsifiable experiment before execution; expose contradictions and failed thresholds; score on fresh episodes kept separate from implementation fixtures.
records.adoption_status: Recommendation; a separate agent's review is useful internal review, not institutionally independent evaluation.
records.license_observation: Public program description; no code, model, or dataset license assessed; no external material imported.
records.boundary: Program aims are not demonstrated SZL outcomes. Only iarpa.gov is treated as this agency's official domain; unrelated iarpa.org search results were excluded.

records.title: Foundation Models for Scientific Discovery (FoundSci)
records.dated_reference: Program identifier DARPA-PA-23-04-01; the page does not state a publication date.
records.source_finding: FoundSci describes skeptical reasoning, uncertainty, and iterative hypothesis/experiment refinement as scientific-discovery research objectives. The page marks the program complete and no longer maintained.
records.proposed_adaptation: Make skepticism operational through a costed verification action and retained revision history, then test whether the action improves measured decisions.
records.adoption_status: Recommendation; no claim that a small synthetic confirmation task meets FoundSci's objectives.
records.license_observation: Public program description; no code, model, or dataset license assessed; no external material imported.
records.boundary: A historical research objective, not evidence of an available autonomous scientist, AGI, or unprecedented method.

original_design_recommendations: A repeated reading from a persistent faulty source is not new independent evidence. Track source identities and shared-error assumptions explicitly.
Use a separately modeled reference channel with a stated error rate and real cost, including a condition where it is imperfect. Calling a source independent is a model assumption that needs testing.
Choose between new coverage, repeated measurement, independent verification, and stopping using expected decision benefit minus acquisition cost.
Report raw accuracy, cost, net utility, confident-error mass, and coverage separately. Lower confidence alone does not establish better decisions.
Compare a policy assuming independent readings against a policy representing correlated faults under the same episode draws and total budget.
Preserve contrary results and protocol hashes. No improvement threshold should be changed after observing the held-out results.
recommendation_attribution: The six design recommendations are our engineering synthesis. The official sources motivate evidence discipline but do not specify or validate this sensor model, cost function, or benchmark.
